--STEPS:

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerName_WITH_DUP_20230606]
( 
    [RN] [INT] NOT NULL,
	[CustomerId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[CustomerNameId] [varbinary](8000)  NOT NULL,
	[NameUsageId] [nvarchar](32)  NULL,
	[StartDate] [date]  NULL,
	[EndDate] [date]  NULL,
	[CustomerNameNote] [nvarchar](128)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [nvarchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[SourceSystemCode] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO





--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT top 100 CustomerId, CustomerNameId, NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerName -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerId, CustomerNameId, NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerId, CustomerNameId, NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ORDER BY EndDate DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
*  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.CustomerName;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerName_WITH_DUP_20230606
--244757
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerName
--244757

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.CustomerName;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.CustomerName --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[CustomerId]
,[CustomerNameId]
,[NameUsageId]
,[StartDate]
,[EndDate]
,[CustomerNameNote]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM bnkm.CustomerName_WITH_DUP_20230606 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  CustomerId, CustomerNameId, NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerName -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerId, CustomerNameId, NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerName_WITH_DUP_20230606
--244757
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerName
--244757
